cgu.intro: Welcome to our site. These Terms of Use define the rules applicable to the use of our platform.

Not to attempt to disrupt the operation of the site.

section4.p2: The user is responsible for the confidentiality of their login credentials and for any activity carried out from their account.

section5.p2: Any reproduction, representation, modification, or use of all or part of the site without prior authorization may constitute an infringement of intellectual property rights.

section6.heading: 6. Liability

section6.p2: The user acknowledges using the site at their own responsibility and remains responsible for their equipment, their internet connection, and their use of the services.

section7.heading: 7. Personal data

section7.p2: This processing is carried out in accordance with applicable regulations on the protection of personal data.
section7.p3: For more information, please refer to our privacy policy.

section8.heading: 8. External links

section9.heading: 9. Changes to the terms
section9.p1: We reserve the right to modify these Terms of Use at any time in order to adapt them to changes in the site, its services, or applicable regulations.
section9.p2: The new terms take effect as soon as they are published on the site.

section10.heading: 10. Applicable law

section10.p2: In the event of a dispute, the parties will endeavor to seek an amicable solution before any legal proceedings.
